quests.title: Adventure at Wavey Bay

dialogue.t: An easy-breezy Natlan in an easy-breezy summer! Welcome to Wavey Bay!
Our facilities aren't fully ready yet. If you're eager to participate, feel free to lend a hand.
Ooh, perfect timing! Perhaps you could help me test this facility?
This one's even further behind... technically, it's still under construction.
Ah, it's you again! Without your help, I'd be out of a job by now.
Greet our tester and start testing!
Thank you! Please give our attraction a try, too.
This is our star parade attraction. Could you lend us a hand?

quests.description: Mualani seems excited about the Wavey Bay attractions. Go meet up with her!
